title: Annotatio VI §.VII close: that head confirms presence for faithful; invites repentance — before §.VIII
pass_a_gloss: Confirms that true and real presence of Christ’s body and blood in the Holy Supper of which the Faithful by eating are made partakers, while the Unfaithful, though eating the bread of the Lord, remain without share; it also pulls men back from Carnal security, lest they imagine they can become partakers of Christ’s body while wallowing in the foulest sins; it convicts the pious of the abundance of divine Charity toward them, by which He imparts his Son’s vivifying flesh as pledge of fatherly love, the same justly denied to the Impious as counterfeits; Finally it invites to true serious repentance and so to more frequent use of the Supper — inasmuch as without that repentance no participation of Christ’s vivifying flesh is to be hoped — and to be obtained all the more richly the more often anyone instructed with true repentance and faith approaches the Lord’s Holy Supper.
pass_b_english: That doctrine confirms real presence for faithful partakers; the unfaithful may eat the Lord’s bread and still remain without share.

It pulls men from carnal security, shows the pious the Father’s gift of vivifying flesh, denies it to the Impious as counterfeits, and invites true repentance and frequent worthy approach. Stop §.VII before §.VIII.
source_text: Veram realémque præsentiam corporis & sanguinis Christi in S. Cœna, istam scilicet confirmat, cujus Fideles manducando redduntur participes, Infideles, panem licèt Domini manducantes, expertes tamen manent; à securitate etiam Carnali homines retrahit, ne sibi imaginentur, se Christi corporis participes fieri posse, in spurcissimis utut peccatis volutati; de Charitatis divinæ erga se abundantia convincit pios, quâ illis filii sui carnem vivificantem, in pignus paterni amoris, impertit, impiis, ceu supposititiis, eâdem jure meritóque denegatâ; Denique ad veram seriamque pœnitentiam, sicque ad usum Cœnæ frequentiorem invitat, utpote citra quam pœnitentiam, nulla carnis Christi vivificantis participatio speranda est — obtinenda autem tantò copiosius, quantò frequentiùs verâ pœnitentiâ & fide instructus quispiam, S. Domini Cœnam accedit.
notes: Fruits of true Indignorum head; before §.VIII.
